description.narrative: ltpgtSamaritan’s Purse (SP) seeks to increase the winter preparedness of Ukrainians living in and/or returning to their homes in the 2024-2025 winter months, as well as, reduce the negative impacts of harsh winter weather for approximately 1,810 households (HHs) or 5,430 individuals across Chernihiv, Kherson, Donetsk, and Zaporizhzhia Oblasts through the timely provision of winter energy and winter non-food items (NFIs). The solid fuel for winter energy needs will be in the form of quality firewood, in line with Ukraine Shelter Cluster 2024-2025 Winterization Recommendations, and will be distributed at the onset of winter, serving as a critical source of winter energy, providing life-saving warmth to the homes of conflict-affected people. Firewood will be distributed door-to-door at six cubic meters per HH and will be measured with an innovative system to ensure an appropriate and equitable amount of firewood is distributed to each HH.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe winter NFI blackout kit was developed based on an internal needs assessment conducted by SP’s NFI team in frontline oblasts and is harmonized with Shelter Cluster recommendations. The winter NFI blackout kit contains one 2L thermos, one 10L jerry can, one 10L bucket, one solar power bank, one solar light, and three thermal blankets. This kit is designed to address specific critical needs in relation to the lack of access to critical infrastructure in the winter such as electricity, gas, and/or water on the household level, such as:lt/pgtltpgtltbrgt- ltbgt2L thermos lt/bgtto keep liquids hot or cold, ensuring household access to warm drinks or meals.ltbrgt- ltbgt10L jerrylt/bgt can to provide a means to store and transport clean water, which is vital when access to water supply is disrupted.ltbrgt- ltbgt10L bucketlt/bgt, which is useful for collecting water, washing, etc., which be used in combination with the jerry can to manage water needs efficiently when HH water supply is unreliable.ltbrgt- ltbgtSolar power banklt/bgt which offers a renewable energy source for charging essential devices like mobile phones, which ensures that the household members can stay connected and informed even when there is no access to electricity.ltbrgt- ltbgtSolar lightlt/bgt which provides a reliable source of light during power outages or during long winter nights, enhancing safety and allowing for activities to continue after dark.ltbrgt- ltbgtThree thermal blanketslt/bgt which can serve to keep household members warm, especially in extreme cold weather, and can be used for emergency warmth or as an additional layer of insulation in bedding.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtOverall, these activities aim to holistically address basic needs by providing items for water storage and transportation, warmth, lighting, and power, to aid individuals experiencing unreliable or non-existent critical infrastructure during winter months.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe project will support vulnerable men, women, boys, and girls living in frontline communities, prioritizing meaningful support to older persons, female-headed HHs, and persons with disabilities. By delivering principled and timely assistance, the project aims to meet emergency needs and provide immediate relief through essential NFI provision, aligning with the Humanitarian Needs Response Plan (HNRP) Strategic Objective 1 and Shelter and Non-Food Item (SNFI) Objective 2.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtSamaritan’s Purse is committed to localization and will leverage its established network of local partners to execute door-to-door distribution activities. Local government leaders will provide beneficiary lists containing demographic information to partners who will call or visit HHs in-person to verify eligibility (does HH have a wood-burning stove, etc.) cross-checking it against vulnerability criteria (above age 60, a disabled individual living in the HH, etc.). This approach ensures the delivery of contextually appropriate assistance to vulnerable individuals in hard-to-reach areas, promoting inclusivity and equitable access to aid. Additionally, it enhances the capacity of local partners to effectively meet the needs of their communities. ltbrgtlt/pgt
